title: Faster Statistics and remembered login
summary: Statistics now reuses recent calculations and keeps Most Watched collapsed until you open it. Optional login can remember a browser for up to 90 days, Settings has a responsive two-column layout on wide screens, and custom Docker runs now respect TZ.
highlights: Reuse recent Statistics calculations while the Devices section continues to refresh separately.
Load fewer History fields during a fresh Statistics calculation and ask Jellyfin for less library metadata.
Open Most Watched only when you want it. Its poster images wait until the section is expanded.
Select Keep me signed in with optional authentication to restore login on that browser for up to 90 days.
Use the redesigned Settings workspace across desktop, tablet, and phone, with the save action kept in the page header.
Honor APP_TIMEZONE or the standard Docker TZ variable across the web app and background workers, with UTC as the fallback.
